tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated New Relic user profile including email, name, accounts, and organization.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all New Relic accounts accessible to the current user.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get the current New Relic organization details including ID and name.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search for monitored entities (applications, hosts, dashboards, synthetic monitors, etc.) by query. Use domain filters like "domain IN ('APM', 'INFRA', 'BROWSER')" or type filters like "type = 'APPLICATION'". Combine with name search: "name LIKE 'my-app'".

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific monitored entity by its GUID.

tools.name: list_entity_tags
tools.description: List all tags on a specific entity. Tags are key-value pairs used for filtering and organizing entities.

tools.name: add_entity_tags
tools.description: Add tags to an entity. Each tag is a key-value pair. Adding a tag with an existing key appends the value.

tools.name: delete_entity_tags
tools.description: Delete tags from an entity by tag key. Removes all values for the specified keys.

tools.name: run_nrql_query
tools.description: Execute a NRQL (New Relic Query Language) query against an account. Returns raw query results. Examples: "SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction SINCE 1 hour ago", "SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction FACET appName SINCE 1 day ago", "SHOW EVENT TYPES".

tools.name: list_event_types
tools.description: List all available event types in a New Relic account. Event types are the data sources you can query with NRQL (e.g., Transaction, SystemSample, PageView).

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards accessible to the current user. Returns dashboard names, GUIDs, permissions, and page details.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific dashboard by its GUID, including pages and widgets.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new dashboard with pages and widgets. Each page must have at least one widget. Widget types include markdown, billboard, table, line, bar, pie, and area charts powered by NRQL queries.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update an existing dashboard. Replaces the entire dashboard definition — provide all pages and widgets, not just changes.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Permanently delete a dashboard by its GUID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_alert_policies
tools.description: List alert policies for a New Relic account. Policies group related alert conditions together and define the incident preference (per-policy, per-condition, or per-condition-and-target).

tools.name: create_alert_policy
tools.description: Create a new alert policy. The incident preference controls how incidents are grouped: PER_POLICY (one incident per policy), PER_CONDITION (one per condition), or PER_CONDITION_AND_TARGET (one per condition and target).

tools.name: delete_alert_policy
tools.description: Permanently delete an alert policy and all its conditions. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_nrql_conditions
tools.description: List NRQL-based alert conditions for an account. Optionally filter by policy ID. NRQL conditions trigger alerts when a NRQL query result crosses a threshold.

tools.name: create_nrql_condition
tools.description: Create a NRQL-based static alert condition. The condition evaluates the NRQL query and triggers when the result crosses the critical threshold.

tools.name: update_nrql_condition
tools.description: Update an existing NRQL alert condition. All fields are required — this replaces the entire condition definition.

tools.name: delete_nrql_condition
tools.description: Permanently delete a NRQL alert condition. This action cannot be undone.
